name: Ethylhexyl oleate
description: Ethylhexyl oleate (CAS 26399-02-0 ), also known by the trade name SABODERM EO, is an ester of oleic acid and 2-ethylhexanol used across personal care, lubricant, and polymer industries. It functions as an emollient, plasticizer, and carrier solvent, valued for its low viscosity and compatibility with a broad range of formulation bases. In personal care, it is used as an emollient and skin-conditioning carrier. It is frequently found in lotions, sunscreens, and color cosmetics, where it delivers a lightweight, non-greasy skin feel. Industrial lubricant formulators incorporate it into metalworking fluids and cutting oils. It serves as a base fluid or co-lubricant, where its ester structure provides good boundary lubrication on metal surfaces. In plastics processing, it acts as a plasticizer and softener for PVC and other polymer systems. This material improves flexibility without significant migration. It also functions as a solvent and carrier for active ingredients, pigments, and UV filters in both cosmetic and industrial coating formulations. Ethylhexyl oleate is supplied as a clear, pale yellow liquid. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with cosmetic-grade material meeting purity standards suitable for personal care manufacturing. Packaging typically ranges from drums to IBC containers for bulk industrial supply.
